Lina (People Ops): Thanks for the all-hands. Opening this thread to capture follow-ups on the hiring playbook, headcount rebalancing, and how reorg requests will be handled.

Marco (CTO): TL;DR: we have funding for ~11 hires this quarter. Priority: runtime optimizations, Dedicated launch support, and customer integrations. Some slots are flexible and can be reallocated if priorities change.

Janet (Director, Eng): Can you confirm which slots are flexible vs locked to a team? Need to plan sprints.

Lina (People Ops): Flexible slots: up to 3 open slots we can move across teams with exec sign-off. Locked slots: hires tied to Dedicated milestones (2 infra, 1 SRE).

Ravi (Eng Manager): Mobility question: if an internal IC applies to a flex slot, do we require a coverage plan before approval?

Marco (CTO): Yes. Any internal move that affects on-call or committed delivery needs a one-paragraph coverage plan from the losing lead. No silent moves.

talent-bot: Resource pinned: "Q3 headcount playbook" https://redwood.company/s/people/q3-playbook :pushpin:

Lina (People Ops): Proposed offer waves: 2026-05-10, 2026-05-31, 2026-06-21. We'll space waves to limit concurrent ramping to 2 hires per team where possible. Mentor guidance: ~12 hours/week first month.

Janet (Director, Eng): Please add geo/on-site flags per req. Some Dedicated pairing needs local presence.

Lina (People Ops): Agreed. We'll annotate each req and add a short FAQ to the tracker. I'll post the final tracker here after calibration.

Ravi (Eng Manager): Thanks. One ask: add a quick note on how backfills are prioritized vs growth roles. Helps set expectations for my team.

Lina (People Ops): Will add: "backfills first for roles impacting SLAs; growth roles prioritized by product ROI and exec alignment." If anything urgent, DM me.
